content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

Through my support of the retail banking team, I help to ensure customers enjoy a positive experience and relationship with Averon Trust Bank.

I am proud to be a part of an amazing team that strives every day to live by our mission to help individuals reach their goals. Led by our core values, we support the community we deeply care about.

A Little About Me

I joined the Averon Trust team in 1999 as a part-time teller, and have earned several promotions in retail banking before I became Assistant Treasurer.

I am a 2010 graduate of the Chamber of Commerce of Eastern CT Leadership Program, a 2015 graduate of the Forte Professional Management Series, and a 2017 graduate of the Global School of Finance and Management. I’ve also proudly participated in countless CGB training programs that foster continuous learning for personal and professional growth.

I received a 2013 George Strouse Spirit Award for embodying and consistently demonstrating the values and spirit of Averon Trust Bank. For over 20 years I have forged meaningful relationships with customers and co-workers.

I am actively involved in the community volunteering at Bank-sponsored and community events. 

My family and I reside in Griswold, CT.
